mapper.select: SELECT category_no, category_name, parent_category_no, category_level, CASE WHEN category_level = 1 THEN '/pds/category_' || category_no || '.png' END AS img_url FROM CATEGORY START WITH parent_category_no IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR category_no = parent_category_no AND LEVEL <= 3 ORDER SIBLINGS BY category_no

SELECT category_no, category_name, parent_category_no, category_level, SUBSTR(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(category_name, ' > '), 4) AS category_path FROM CATEGORY WHERE CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF = 1 AND category_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' START WITH parent_category_no IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR category_no = parent_category_no ORDER BY category_no
